title: How many visits of Bellbird Home Nursing's 850-visit January to March 2027 Hospital in the Home overflow block each of Ironbark Health Alliance's five members books
subdomain: utilization-access-demand-forecasting (Hospital in the Home capacity: each member's 90th-percentile visit requirement for a quarter not yet open, built from planned admissions and the stays on file, against a capped block of contract visits booked in a filed order)
